name: Where is the best location in a home to add a new bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Where is the best location in a home to add a new bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing runs are easiest and most cost-effective when placed back-to-back or vertically aligned with existing plumbing lines. Positioning the new bathroom adjacent to a kitchen, laundry room, or existing bathroom minimizes the distance necessary to tap into hot and cold water supplies and connects directly to the existing sewer stack. Placing a new bathroom far from existing utilities requires trenching through concrete slab foundations or running long drain slopes beneath subfloors, which adds labor complexity and extends the overall rough-in schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best location shares a common wall or plumbing wet wall with an existing bathroom, kitchen, or laundry room to shorten pipe runs and reduce tie-in work.
